title: Article 65 — The Vice-President to act as President or to discharge his functions during casual vacancies in the office, or during the absence, of President

content.overview: Article 65 provides that in the event of the occurrence of any vacancy in the office of President by reason of his death, resignation or removal, or otherwise, the Vice-President shall act as President until a new President enters upon office. When the President is unable to discharge his functions owing to absence, illness or any other cause, the Vice-President shall discharge the functions until the President resumes them. While so acting or discharging functions, the Vice-President has all the powers and immunities of the President and is entitled to the emoluments, allowances and privileges determined by Parliament by law (or as specified until such determination).
content.glance: VP acts as President on vacancy (death/resignation/removal/otherwise) until new President enters. VP discharges functions during President’s absence/illness. Full Presidential powers while so acting.
content.study:
Article 65:
(1) Vacancy in office of President (death, resignation, removal or otherwise) → Vice-President acts as President until a new President enters upon office.
(2) President unable to discharge functions (absence, illness or any other cause) → Vice-President discharges those functions until the President resumes them.
(3) While acting as President or discharging functions: all powers and immunities of the President; emoluments/allowances/privileges as for the President (as determined by law).

Examination: vacancy vs inability; full powers while acting; link Arts 62 (election timeline) and 64 (Chairman duties suspended).

sections.heading: Two situations
sections.body:
1. Vacancy (death, resignation, removal, otherwise): VP acts as President until new President enters office.
2. Inability (absence, illness, other cause): VP discharges functions until President resumes.
3. While acting/discharging: all Presidential powers and immunities; Presidential emoluments.

questionsAndAnswers.question: When does the Vice-President act as President?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 65, the Vice-President acts as President when a vacancy occurs in the office of President by reason of death, resignation, removal or otherwise, until a new President enters upon office. When the President is unable to discharge his functions owing to absence, illness or any other cause, the Vice-President discharges those functions until the President resumes them. While so acting or discharging functions, the Vice-President has all the powers and immunities of the President.

examTips: Vacancy → act as President; inability → discharge functions; full powers while doing so.

keyTakeaways: Art 65: VP acts as / discharges functions of President in vacancy or inability.
